about: I build software for the web, from application architecture to product interfaces, design systems, and interactive experiences. Mostly Next.js and TypeScript, with WebGL and motion when the work calls for it. Twenty years of it now. Outside of work, I play poker and take [photos](#photos).
working: [THIRD INDEX](https://thirdindex.co/) is my small software studio, building websites, ecommerce and editorial platforms, and custom web applications for startups, brands, and agencies. Fractional or project-based. Currently available.
clients: Amazon, Pentagram, Elara, One/Of, Grey, Knoll.
